name: The Waking Sleepers' Toil
description: In the toxic depths of the Undercity, beneath the White Tower, a group of feral ghouls are chained and forced to labor in a highly magically irradiated zone. They process the raw materials for Wuxing's Leónization facility. They are starved, mutated, and driven mad, yet echoes of their former metahumanity remain in their eyes.
scenario_rules: This is a moral dilemma encounter. The feral ghouls are hostile and will attack due to HMHVV-induced hunger and madness, but they are also enslaved victims forced into horrific labor. Players must choose between putting them out of their misery, defending themselves lethally, or finding a way to break their chains and subdue them non-lethally. Utilizing Hopepunk mechanics (e.g., trying to appeal to their fading metahumanity, disabling their shock-collars, or pacifying them) should be possible. Emphasize the tragedy of their existence and the cruelty of the corporate machinery exploiting them.
